invariants.label: H3ProximityAccuracy
invariants.doc: CheckSpatial1 verifies SPATIAL-1: H3ProximityAccuracy. Ensures H3-based proximity detection matches haversine-based detection. This is a calibration invariant used during the H3 migration to verify accuracy.  Checks: 1. If H3 says "within 10 miles", haversine should confirm < 11 miles (10% buffer) 2. If H3 says "within 5 miles", haversine should confirm < 5.5 miles 3. If H3 says "within 1 mile", haversine should confirm < 1.1 miles  OPTIMIZED: Builds lookup maps once, uses fast distance check for common case.

invariants.label: ProximityStateConsistent
invariants.doc: CheckSpatial2 verifies SPATIAL-2: ProximityStateConsistent. Ensures proximity state "at_location" matches actual driver location in geofence.  Real-world failure this prevents: Driver marked as present when they're not, leading to fraudulent dwell time payouts.  OPTIMIZED: Uses squared distance comparison to avoid sqrt, builds stop lookup once.

invariants.label: ShadowTrackingAccuracy
invariants.doc: CheckSpatial3 verifies SPATIAL-3: ShadowTrackingAccuracy. Ensures shadow tracking events are only generated for valid GPS gaps and that confidence scores are calculated correctly.  Real-world failure this prevents: 1. False positive shadow activities for small gaps (<10 minutes) 2. Shadow activities with incorrect confidence (timing mismatch) 3. Activities generated for impossible routes (cells too far apart)  Checks: - All generated shadow activities have gaps >= MinGapTicks - All generated shadow activities have gaps <= MaxGapTicks - All generated shadow activities have confidence >= 0.6 - No shadow activities generated for gaps < MinGapTicks

invariants.label: NoFutureTimestamps
invariants.doc: CheckTemporal1 verifies TEMPORAL-1: NoFutureTimestamps. Ping timestamps must not be in the future relative to the server clock. This catches clock manipulation attacks.

invariants.label: NoExcessiveClockDrift
invariants.doc: CheckTemporal2 verifies TEMPORAL-2: NoExcessiveClockDrift. Ensures client timestamps don't drift too far from server clock.  Real-world failure this prevents: Clock manipulation attacks where malicious clients send timestamps in the past/future to game dwell time calculations.

invariants.label: DwellTimeValid
invariants.doc: CheckTemporal3 verifies TEMPORAL-3: DwellTimeValid. Ensures completed stops have valid dwell times with sufficient pings.  Real-world failure this prevents: Drive-by fraud where a driver briefly enters a geofence without actually performing the stop.

invariants.label: PayoutFollowsDriver
invariants.doc: CheckIdentity1 verifies IDENTITY-1: PayoutFollowsDriver. A shipment's payout must go to the driver who was assigned when completed. This prevents payout misdirection after driver reassignment.

invariants.label: OnlyAssignedDriverCompletes
invariants.doc: CheckIdentity2 verifies IDENTITY-2: OnlyAssignedDriverCompletes. Ensures stops are only completed by drivers who were assigned to the shipment.  Real-world failure this prevents: Driver impersonation attacks or system bugs that allow an unassigned driver to complete another driver's stops.

invariants.label: AssignmentHistoryComplete
invariants.doc: CheckIdentity3 verifies IDENTITY-3: AssignmentHistoryComplete. Ensures the current driver matches the last assignment in history.  Real-world failure this prevents: Inconsistent state where shipment shows one driver but assignment history shows another, causing payout confusion.

invariants.label: SingleActiveShipmentPerDriver
invariants.doc: CheckIdentity4 verifies IDENTITY-4: SingleActiveShipmentPerDriver. Ensures that each driver has at most ONE in_progress shipment at any time.  TLA+ Specification:  ∀ d ∈ Drivers: |{s ∈ Shipments : shipmentDriver[s] = d ∧ shipmentStatus[s] = "in_progress"}| ≤ 1  This invariant prevents: - A driver from accepting a new shipment while already driving - Concurrent delivery scenarios which are physically impossible - Duplicate payout situations where one driver completes multiple shipments  In the real world, a driver can only be in one place at a time. This invariant is critical for future Stripe sandbox integration where each driver has a corresponding Connect account.

invariants.label: TerminalStatesAreFinal
invariants.doc: CheckCausal1 verifies CAUSAL-1: TerminalStatesAreFinal. Completed or cancelled shipments must never change status again. This prevents the scenario where a completed shipment is somehow reopened.

invariants.label: StopOrderingRespected
invariants.doc: CheckCausal2 verifies CAUSAL-2: StopOrderingRespected. Ensures stops are completed in sequence order (lower sequence completed first).  Real-world failure this prevents: Out-of-order stop completion that violates pickup-before-delivery constraints or multi-stop routing logic.

invariants.label: ShipmentRequiresAllStops
invariants.doc: CheckCausal3 verifies CAUSAL-3: ShipmentRequiresAllStops. Ensures completed shipments have all their stops completed.  Real-world failure this prevents: Premature shipment completion that skips required stops, leading to missing deliveries and incorrect payouts.

invariants.label: SpeedPlausibility
invariants.doc: CheckPhysics1 verifies PHYSICS-1: SpeedPlausibility. No sequential pings should exceed MaxSpeedMPH (165 mph). This catches teleportation attacks in the simulator.

invariants.label: NoBilocation
invariants.doc: CheckPhysics2 verifies PHYSICS-2: NoBilocation. Pings at the same clock tick must be at the same location (within GPS tolerance). This detects multi-device attacks where pings arrive concurrently from different locations.  OPTIMIZED: Zero allocation - checks consecutive pings with same timestamp inline.

invariants.label: HeartbeatRequired
invariants.doc: CheckContinuity1 verifies CONTINUITY-1: HeartbeatRequired. Ensures active drivers have recent pings (within MaxPingGap ticks).  Real-world failure this prevents: "Ghost" drivers who start a shipment but then go offline, making tracking impossible and causing dispatch confusion.

invariants.label: PingDensityRequired
invariants.doc: CheckContinuity2 verifies CONTINUITY-2: PingDensityRequired. Ensures completed stops have sufficient ping density within geofence.  Real-world failure this prevents: Low-quality location data that can't reliably establish presence, leading to disputed dwell time claims.

invariants.label: NoMoneyWithoutRecord
invariants.doc: CheckPayment2 verifies PAYMENT-2: NoMoneyWithoutRecord. FIX: Now uses ShipmentID for matching when available, to prevent false positives when same driver has multiple payouts of the same amount.

invariants.label: NoRecordWithoutCompletion
invariants.doc: CheckPayment3 verifies PAYMENT-3: NoRecordWithoutCompletion.

invariants.label: NoDoublePayouts
invariants.doc: CheckPayment4 verifies PAYMENT-4: NoDoublePayouts.

invariants.label: NoUnpaidCompletedWork
invariants.doc: CheckPayment5 verifies PAYMENT-5: NoUnpaidCompletedWork.

invariants.label: BalanceImpliesCredit
invariants.doc: CheckPayment6 verifies PAYMENT-6: BalanceImpliesCredit.

invariants.label: NoRestrictedWithdrawals
invariants.doc: CheckPayment7 verifies PAYMENT-7: NoRestrictedWithdrawals.

invariants.label: IdempotencyRespected
invariants.doc: CheckPayment8 verifies PAYMENT-8: IdempotencyRespected.

invariants.label: NoIdempotencyKeyReuse
invariants.doc: CheckPayment9 verifies PAYMENT-9: NoIdempotencyKeyReuse. Expired keys must not be reused - this is a safety violation.

invariants.label: NoInvalidStateTransitions
invariants.doc: CheckPayment10 verifies PAYMENT-10: NoInvalidStateTransitions. All recorded state transitions must be valid according to state machine.

invariants.label: DualStateConsistency
invariants.doc: CheckPayment11 verifies PAYMENT-11: DualStateConsistency. Our transfer records must eventually match Stripe reality (except during known crash scenarios).

invariants.label: NoOrphanedPending
invariants.doc: CheckPayment12 verifies PAYMENT-12: NoOrphanedPending. Transfers cannot remain in "pending" state indefinitely - they must resolve. Uses logical clock ticks for deterministic simulation.  Real-world failure this prevents: Stripe webhook never arrives, money stuck in limbo forever. Driver can't withdraw, reconciliation never runs.

invariants.label: NoStaleTransfers
invariants.doc: CheckPayment13 verifies PAYMENT-13: NoStaleTransfers. Transfers must not remain in pending state beyond a reasonable time. Unlike PAYMENT-12 which checks for reconciliation gaps, PAYMENT-13 checks for truly abandoned transfers that have no corresponding Stripe reality (never processed).  Real-world failure this prevents: Transfer created but never submitted to Stripe, funds stuck in limbo, no webhook ever arrives because Stripe never got the request.

invariants.label: SumOfPartsEqualsWhole
invariants.doc: CheckPayment14 verifies PAYMENT-14: SumOfPartsEqualsWhole. The sum of all driver balances must equal the net of all ledger entries. This catches rounding errors, double-counting, and missed entries.  Formula: Sum(driver_balances.available + pending) == Sum(ledger credits) - Sum(ledger debits)  Real-world failure this prevents: Rounding errors accumulate over thousands of transactions. A 1-cent error per transaction becomes $100k/year at scale.

invariants.label: NoPayoutsToInvalidAccounts
invariants.doc: CheckPayment15 verifies PAYMENT-15: NoPayoutsToInvalidAccounts. No payouts should be created or pending for drivers with invalid external accounts.  TLA+ Specification:  ∀ t ∈ stripeTransfers: t.status = "pending" ⇒ driverExternalAccount[t.driver] = "valid"

invariants.label: ExpiredCardBlocksPayout
invariants.doc: CheckPayment16 verifies PAYMENT-16: ExpiredCardBlocksPayout. Payouts should not be pending for drivers with expired cards.  TLA+ Specification:  ∀ t ∈ stripeTransfers: t.status = "pending" ∧ clock >= driverCardExpiry[t.driver] ⇒ driverExternalAccount[t.driver] ≠ "valid"

invariants.label: InstantPayoutEligibility
invariants.doc: CheckPayment17 verifies PAYMENT-17: InstantPayoutEligibility. Instant payouts should only be created for eligible drivers.  TLA+ Specification:  ∀ t ∈ stripeTransfers: t.status = "pending" ∧ t.method = "instant" ⇒ driverInstantEligible[t.driver] ∧ driverCardNetwork[t.driver] ∈ {"visa", "mastercard"} ∧ driverExternalAccount[t.driver] = "valid"

invariants.label: InstantFailureFallback
invariants.doc: CheckPayment18 verifies PAYMENT-18: InstantFailureFallback. Failed instant payouts for specific codes should have standard fallback scheduled.  TLA+ Specification:  ∀ f ∈ payoutFailures: f.failureCode ∈ {"instant_payouts_unsupported", "daily_limit_exceeded", "network_decline"} ⇒ ∃ retry ∈ pendingRetries: retry.transferId = f.transferId ∧ retry.method = "standard"

invariants.label: CardReplacementHandling
invariants.doc: CheckPayment19 verifies PAYMENT-19: CardReplacementHandling. Pending payouts should be voided when the card is replaced.  TLA+ Specification:  ∀ t ∈ stripeTransfers: t.status = "pending" ∧ driverExternalAccount[t.driver] = "replaced" ⇒ t.status' ∈ {"voided", "failed"}

invariants.label: NetworkBlackoutRespected
invariants.doc: CheckPayment20 verifies PAYMENT-20: NetworkBlackoutRespected. No instant payout may be in flight while the destination card network is in a blackout window. Standard payouts and already-settled transfers are exempt.  TLA+ Specification:  ∀ t ∈ stripeTransfers: t.status = "pending" ∧ t.method = "instant" ⇒ ¬IsBlackoutWindow(driverCardNetwork[t.driver], clock)

invariants.label: RetryBudgetRespected
invariants.doc: CheckPayment21 verifies PAYMENT-21: RetryBudgetRespected. Payouts that exhaust retries should have permanent failure recorded.  TLA+ Specification:  ∀ f ∈ payoutFailures: |{r ∈ pendingRetries: r.transferId = f.transferId}| >= MAX_RETRIES ⇒ ∃ entry ∈ ledgerEntries: entry.type = "payout_failed"

invariants.label: InProgressRequiresDriver
invariants.doc: CheckState1 verifies STATE-1: InProgressRequiresDriver. Shipments in 'in_progress' status must have a driver assigned. This prevents orphaned shipments that can never be completed.

invariants.label: ExternalAccountConsistency
invariants.doc: CheckState2 verifies STATE-2: ExternalAccountConsistency. Our external account status should match Stripe's reality.  TLA+ Specification:  ∀ d ∈ Drivers: driverExternalAccount[d] = "valid" ⇒ ∃ acct ∈ stripeExternalAccounts: acct.driver = d ∧ acct.status = "valid" ∧ acct.expiry > clock

invariants.label: PendingPayoutsHaveValidDestination
invariants.doc: CheckState3 verifies STATE-3: PendingPayoutsHaveValidDestination. All pending payouts should have a valid destination.  TLA+ Specification:  ∀ t ∈ stripeTransfers: t.status = "pending" ⇒ driverExternalAccount[t.driver] = "valid" ∧ driverAccountStatus[t.driver] = "active"

invariants.label: CardExpiryTracked
invariants.doc: CheckState4 verifies STATE-4: CardExpiryTracked. Card expiry should be tracked and enforced.  TLA+ Specification:  ∀ d ∈ Drivers: driverCardExpiry[d] > 0 ∧ clock >= driverCardExpiry[d] ⇒ driverExternalAccount[d] ∈ {"expired", "replaced"}

invariants.label: NoOrphanedPayoutFailures
invariants.doc: CheckState5 verifies STATE-5: NoOrphanedPayoutFailures. All payout failures should have a handling path.  TLA+ Specification:  ∀ f ∈ payoutFailures: (∃ retry ∈ pendingRetries: retry.transferId = f.transferId) ∨  -- Will retry f.failureCode ∈ TerminalFailures ∨                            -- Permanent failure (∃ entry ∈ ledgerEntries: entry.type = "payout_failed")       -- Refunded to balance

invariants.label: TotalPayoutsCannotExceedRevenue
invariants.doc: CheckEconomics1 verifies ECONOMICS-1: TotalPayoutsCannotExceedRevenue. The platform cannot pay out more than it has earned.  TLA+ Specification:  platform.TotalPayoutsCents ≤ platform.TotalRevenueCents

invariants.label: PendingPayoutsWithinFloat
invariants.doc: CheckEconomics2 verifies ECONOMICS-2: PendingPayoutsWithinFloat. Cannot have pending payouts exceeding available balance + max allowed float.  TLA+ Specification:  sumPendingPayouts ≤ platform.AvailableBalance + maxFloatExposure

invariants.label: ShipmentRequiresCredit
invariants.doc: CheckEconomics3 verifies ECONOMICS-3: ShipmentRequiresCredit. Every in_progress or completed shipment must have a credit reservation.  TLA+ Specification:  ∀ s ∈ Shipments: s.status ∈ {"in_progress", "completed"} ⇒ ∃ r ∈ Reservations: r.shipmentID = s.id

invariants.label: BrokerCreditsNonNegative
invariants.doc: CheckEconomics4 verifies ECONOMICS-4: BrokerCreditsNonNegative. No broker can have negative available credits.  TLA+ Specification:  ∀ b ∈ Brokers: b.CreditsPurchased - b.CreditsUsed - b.CreditsRefunded ≥ 0

invariants.label: PayoutNotExceedShipmentRevenue
invariants.doc: CheckEconomics5 verifies ECONOMICS-5: PayoutNotExceedShipmentRevenue. Driver payout cannot exceed credit price (ensures positive margin per shipment).  TLA+ Specification:  payoutCents ≤ economicConstants.CreditPriceCents

invariants.label: RefundNotExceedUnused
invariants.doc: CheckEconomics6 verifies ECONOMICS-6: RefundNotExceedUnused. Cannot refund more credits than broker has unused.  TLA+ Specification:  ∀ b ∈ Brokers: b.CreditsRefunded ≤ b.CreditsPurchased - b.CreditsUsed

invariants.label: MoneyConservation
invariants.doc: CheckEconomics7 verifies ECONOMICS-7: MoneyConservation. Total money in the system must be conserved: Inputs = Outputs + Held.  TLA+ Specification:  ∑(broker.CreditsPurchased * CreditPriceCents) = platform.TotalPayouts + platform.TotalRefunds + platform.AvailableBalance + platform.PendingSettlement + ∑(driverBalance.Available + driverBalance.Pending) + ∑((broker.CreditsPurchased - broker.CreditsUsed - broker.CreditsRefunded) * CreditPriceCents)

faults.label: Payment clawback
faults.doc: Stripe claws back a completed payout

faults.label: Broker credit race
faults.doc: Multiple shipments try to use same credit

faults.label: Refund during shipment
faults.doc: Broker requests refund while shipment in progress

faults.label: Float exposure exceeded
faults.doc: Attempt to exceed float exposure limit

faults.label: Idempotency key expired
faults.doc: FaultIdempotencyExpired models the scenario where a payout's Stripe idempotency key has aged past the 24h replay window. The recovery metadata-search path returning nil is then INDISTINGUISHABLE from "transfer never created" — re-issuing risks a duplicate. The production fix (services/business/ledger/payouts.go) routes such payouts to manual review instead of re-queue. Wired into executeOp case 18; the regression catcher is the manual_review terminal state being reached instead of paid (which would re-credit the driver).

variables.name: GetDriverPayoutCents
variables.doc: Returns the per-shipment driver payout amount

variables.name: CreateShipmentWithID
variables.doc: Returns error if driver cannot accept shipments (INV-32)

variables.name: SimulateIdempotencyExpiry
variables.doc: SimulateIdempotencyExpiry rewinds a transfer's CreatedAtClock past the Stripe idempotency replay window so the next RunReconciliation parks it as manual_review. Used to inject FaultIdempotencyExpired.

specs.name: BalanceImpliesCredit
specs.predicate:
\A d \in Drivers:
    driverBalance[d] > 0 =>
        \E e \in ledgerEntries:
            /\ e.driver = d
            /\ e.type \in {"payout", "reconciled"}
specs.doc: INV-6: Balance Consistency Balance > 0 implies at least one credit entry exists

specs.name: NoDoublePayouts
specs.predicate:
\A s \in Shipments:
    Cardinality({e \in ledgerEntries: e.shipment = s /\ e.type = "payout"}) <= 1
specs.doc: INV-4: No Double Payouts Each shipment has at most one payout entry

specs.name: NoMoneyWithoutRecord
specs.predicate:
\A payment \in stripeRealityPaid:
    \/ payment \in stripeRealityReversed  \* Reversed = forgiven
    \/ \E entry \in ledgerEntries:
        /\ entry.driver = payment.driver
        /\ entry.cents = payment.cents
        /\ entry.type \in {"payout", "reconciled"}
specs.doc: INV-2: No Money Without Record If Stripe actually paid (and hasn't reversed), we must have a ledger entry

specs.name: NoNegativeBalances
specs.predicate: \A d \in Drivers: driverBalance[d] >= 0
specs.doc: INV-1: No Negative Balances A driver's balance can never go negative

specs.name: NoRecordWithoutCompletion
specs.predicate:
\A entry \in ledgerEntries:
    entry.type = "payout" =>
        shipmentState[entry.shipment] = "completed"
specs.doc: INV-3: No Payout Record Without Completion Payout entries only exist for completed shipments

specs.name: NoRestrictedWithdrawals
specs.predicate:
\A w \in withdrawalRequests:
    w.status = "pending" =>
        driverAccountStatus[w.driver] = "active"
specs.doc: INV-7: No Withdrawals From Restricted Accounts Suspended/restricted drivers can't have pending withdrawals

specs.name: NoUnpaidCompletedWork
specs.predicate:
\A s \in Shipments:
    shipmentState[s] = "completed" =>
        \E entry \in ledgerEntries:
            /\ entry.shipment = s
            /\ entry.driver = shipmentDriver[s]
            /\ entry.type = "payout"
specs.doc: INV-5: No Unpaid Completed Work (THE MOST IMPORTANT) Every completed shipment must have a payout entry for the assigned driver. This ensures drivers always get paid for work they've done.

specs.name: TypeOK
specs.predicate:
/\ clock \in Nat
/\ shipmentState \in [Shipments -> ShipmentStates]
/\ shipmentDriver \in [Shipments -> Drivers]
/\ shipmentCompletedAt \in [Shipments -> Nat]
/\ driverBalance \in [Drivers -> Nat]
/\ driverAccountStatus \in [Drivers -> DriverAccountStates]
/\ ledgerEntries \subseteq [shipment: Shipments, driver: Drivers,
                             cents: Nat, type: LedgerTypes, createdAt: Nat]
/\ stripeTransfers \subseteq [id: Nat, driver: Drivers, cents: Nat,
                               status: TransferStatuses,
                               idempotencyKey: Nat, createdAt: Nat]
/\ stripeRealityPaid \subseteq [driver: Drivers, cents: Nat]
/\ stripeRealityReversed \subseteq [driver: Drivers, cents: Nat]
/\ idempotencyKeys \subseteq [key: Nat, status: IdempotencyStatuses, createdAt: Nat]
/\ nextKeyId \in Nat
/\ withdrawalRequests \subseteq [driver: Drivers, cents: Nat,
                                  status: WithdrawalStatuses, createdAt: Nat]

specs.name: CardExpiryTracked
specs.predicate:
\A d \in Drivers:
    /\ driverCardExpiry[d] > 0
    /\ clock >= driverCardExpiry[d]
    => driverExternalAccount[d] \in {"expired", "replaced"}
specs.doc: INV-STATE-7: Card expiry is tracked and enforced

specs.name: CardReplacementHandling
specs.predicate:
\A t \in stripeTransfers:
    /\ t.status = "pending"
    /\ driverExternalAccount[t.driver] = "replaced"
    => FALSE  \* Pending transfers should be voided when card is replaced
specs.doc: INV-PAYMENT-14: Card replacement invalidates pending transfers

specs.name: ExpiredCardBlocksPayout
specs.predicate:
\A t \in stripeTransfers:
    /\ t.status = "pending"
    /\ clock >= driverCardExpiry[t.driver]
    => driverExternalAccount[t.driver] # "valid"
specs.doc: INV-PAYMENT-11: Expired cards must be replaced before payout

specs.name: ExternalAccountConsistency
specs.predicate:
\A d \in Drivers:
    driverExternalAccount[d] = "valid"
    => /\ stripeExternalAccountStatus[d] = "valid"
       /\ stripeExternalAccountExpiry[d] > clock
specs.doc: INV-STATE-5: External account status matches Stripe reality

specs.name: InstantFailureFallback
specs.predicate:
\A f \in payoutFailures:
    ShouldFallbackToStandard(f.failureCode, f.method)
    => \E retry \in pendingRetries:
        /\ retry.transferId = f.transferId
        /\ retry.method = "standard"
specs.doc: INV-PAYMENT-13: Failed instant must have standard fallback option

specs.name: InstantPayoutEligibility
specs.predicate:
\A t \in stripeTransfers:
    /\ t.status = "pending"
    /\ t.method = "instant"
    => /\ driverInstantEligible[t.driver]
       /\ NetworkSupportsInstant(driverCardNetwork[t.driver])
       /\ driverExternalAccount[t.driver] = "valid"
specs.doc: INV-PAYMENT-12: Instant payouts only for eligible drivers Note: Assumes stripeTransfers has a 'method' field in extended model

specs.name: NetworkBlackoutRespected
specs.predicate:
\A t \in stripeTransfers:
    /\ t.status = "pending"
    /\ t.method = "instant"
    /\ driverCardNetwork[t.driver] = "discover"
    => ~IsDiscoverBlackout(clock)
specs.doc: INV-PAYMENT-15: No instant payouts during network blackout windows

specs.name: NoOrphanedPayoutFailures
specs.predicate:
\A f \in payoutFailures:
    \/ \E retry \in pendingRetries: retry.transferId = f.transferId  \* Will retry
    \/ IsTerminalFailure(f.failureCode)  \* Permanent failure
    \/ \E entry \in ledgerEntries:  \* Refunded to balance
        /\ entry.driver = f.driver
        /\ entry.type = "payout_failed"
specs.doc: INV-STATE-8: No orphaned payout failures (all failures have handling path)

specs.name: NoPayoutsToInvalidAccounts
specs.predicate:
\A t \in stripeTransfers:
    t.status = "pending" =>
        driverExternalAccount[t.driver] = "valid"
specs.doc: INV-PAYMENT-10: No payouts to invalid external accounts

specs.name: PendingPayoutsHaveValidDestination
specs.predicate:
\A t \in stripeTransfers:
    t.status = "pending"
    => /\ driverExternalAccount[t.driver] = "valid"
       /\ driverAccountStatus[t.driver] \in {"active", "restricted"}
specs.doc: INV-STATE-6: Pending payouts have valid destination

specs.name: RetryBudgetRespected
specs.predicate:
\A f \in payoutFailures:
    Cardinality({r \in pendingRetries: r.transferId = f.transferId /\ r.retryCount >= MAX_RETRIES}) > 0
    => \E entry \in ledgerEntries:
        /\ entry.driver = f.driver
        /\ entry.type = "payout_failed"
specs.doc: INV-PAYMENT-16: Retry budget exhausted means permanent failure recorded

specs.name: IdempotencyRespected
specs.predicate:
\A t1, t2 \in stripeTransfers:
    (t1.idempotencyKey = t2.idempotencyKey /\ t1 # t2) =>
        (t1.status = t2.status /\ t1.cents = t2.cents)
specs.doc: INV-8: Idempotency Key Uniqueness No two transfers should share the same unexpired idempotency key (Simplified: transfers with same key should have same outcome)

specs.name: AssignmentHistoryComplete
specs.predicate:
\A s \in Shipments:
    Len(driverAssignmentHistory[s]) >= 1 =>
        /\ Head(driverAssignmentHistory[s]) \in Drivers
        /\ shipmentDriver[s] = Last(driverAssignmentHistory[s])
specs.doc: INV-IDENTITY-3: Driver assignment history is complete

specs.name: CancellationCascades
specs.predicate:
\A s \in Shipments:
    shipmentState[s] = "cancelled" =>
        \A stop \in StopsForShipment(s):
            stopStatus[stop] # "completed" =>
                stopStatus[stop] = "cancelled"
specs.doc: INV-CAUSAL-5: Cancellation cascades to stops

specs.name: CompletedLocationImmutable
specs.predicate:
\A lc \in pendingLocationChanges:
    lc.status = "applied" =>
        stopStatus[lc.stop] # "completed"
specs.doc: INV-STATE-4: Completed location immutable

specs.name: DriverShipmentConsistency
specs.predicate:
\A s \in Shipments:
    shipmentState[s] = "in_progress" =>
        \/ shipmentDriver[s] \in Drivers
        \/ s \in {r.shipment: r \in pendingReassignments}
specs.doc: INV-STATE-2: Driver-Shipment consistency

specs.name: DwellTimeValid
specs.predicate:
\A stop \in Stops:
    stopStatus[stop] = "completed" =>
        LET d == stopCompletedBy[stop]
            pingsAtStop == {p \in pingHistory:
                /\ p.driver = d
                /\ Distance(p.location, stopLocation[stop]) <= GEOFENCE_RADIUS
                /\ p.serverTick >= stopArrivalTick[stop]}
        IN /\ Cardinality(pingsAtStop) >= MIN_PINGS_FOR_DWELL
           /\ stopDepartureTick[stop] - stopArrivalTick[stop] >= MIN_DWELL_TICKS
specs.doc: INV-TEMPORAL-3: Dwell time must be real (verified by ping span)

specs.name: FraudCancellationReversal
specs.predicate:
\A s \in Shipments:
    /\ shipmentState[s] = "cancelled"
    /\ cancellationReason[s] = "fraud"
    => ~\E entry \in ledgerEntries:
        /\ entry.shipment = s
        /\ entry.type \in {"payout", "partial_payout"}
        /\ entry.cents > 0
specs.doc: INV-PAYMENT-8: Fraud cancellation reverses all

specs.name: HeartbeatRequired
specs.predicate:
\A stop \in Stops:
    stopPayoutTriggered[stop] =>
        clock - driverLastPingTick[stopCompletedBy[stop]] <= MAX_PING_GAP
specs.doc: INV-CONTINUITY-1: Heartbeat required for payout

specs.name: NoBilocation
specs.predicate:
\A p1, p2 \in pingHistory:
    /\ p1.driver = p2.driver
    /\ p1.serverTick = p2.serverTick
    => p1.location = p2.location
specs.doc: INV-PHYSICS-2: No bilocation (same driver, same tick, different locations)

specs.name: NoDoublePayoutsPerStop
specs.predicate:
\A stop \in Stops:
    Cardinality({e \in ledgerEntries:
